## Web 智慧與資料探勘實驗室
## Web Intelligence and Data Mining Laboratory
### 【Research Interests】

The Web Intelligence and Data Mining Laboratory at National Central University is dedicated to researching and developing intelligent systems to address complex real-world problems. Our research spans Web information extraction, machine learning, data mining, conversational agents, and knowledge graphs, with applications in web intelligence, information integration, legal AI, human-computer interaction, and educational systems. Check some of our projects below.
  * ​​​​​​​​Agentic AI, GUI Automation ​


  * ​Legal AI: Legal Judgement Predication, [Collision Care Guide chatbot](http://140.115.54.36:8230/login), Legigation Visualization


  * [​Meetup Event Extraction](https://eventgo.widm.csie.ncu.edu.tw), Point-of-Interest Extraction​


  * ​AI for Education: [EduACT](https://eduact.csie.ncu.edu.tw), Storybot 


  * ​Smart campus: NCUFree, WiFiPass, Mobile Advertising​​


  * ​Web Information Extraction and Text Mining ​


  * ​Web intelligence: [Mobile Web Creator](http://140.115.54.44:8001/), Opinion mining for social study ​


  * Data Mining, e.g. ​Periodic pattern mining


  * ​Web data extraction: IEPAD, FiVaTech, [Data API Creator ](http://140.115.54.44:8001/)

> 1. 圖片類型與主旨
> 此圖片為一個簡潔的向量圖，描繪了一個表情友善的藍色機器人頭像，並標示「AI」。

> 2. 核心視覺元素與文字
> 主要物件/特徵：
> *   圓形藍色眼睛，眼眶為黑色輪廓。

> *   方形的頭部，頂部有三個紅色的圓點裝飾。
> *   頭部兩側有藍色的圓形突出物，可能代表耳朵或揚聲器。
> *   一個較小的藍色頸部連接到肩膀部位。
> *   肩膀區域呈淺藍色，邊緣有黑色輪廓。

> 圖片中央是一個卡通風格的機器人頭像，主體為淺藍色，具有簡潔的黑色輪廓線。它的臉部設計極具表現力，有兩個圓形眼睛和一個明顯的微笑，臉頰兩側的橫線增添了其可愛的特質。頭部頂部點綴著三個紅色的小圓點。
